claims.text: The case has 101 evidence windows in 5 episodes, from 12:08 to 13:19.
Motor acceleration peak was outside its baseline band in 66 windows over 1 episode; the highest score was 3.61 (band 12.5 to 15.9 m/s²).
Motor accelerometer temperature relative to ambient was outside its baseline band in 12 windows over 1 episode; the highest score was 1.07 (band 3.93 to 23.0 K).
Motor vibration velocity was outside its baseline band in 23 windows over 3 episodes; the highest score was 2.70 (band 0.00243 to 0.00313 m/s).
The pattern in motor acceleration peak may be consistent with a sustained shift away from its run baseline.
Scores are robust band exceedances, not calibrated probabilities, and CIRA has no fault labels, so the data cannot establish a fault.
Replay scores use declared per-day inputs (A8) and fixed settling times (A7).
